title: Measuring the scheduler: where every GPU-hour of this run went, and queue wait by job size
design_ref: Measuring and tuning the scheduler; Where GPU-hours go
purpose: Read the accounting service's breakdown for the whole run (S02 to S10), for the real and the simulated GPUs, per category and per team, and the queue wait of every Kueue workload by size class.

steps.display: queue wait (creation to quota reserved) by job size in GPUs: workloads, median, max, in seconds

checks.description: every sampled GPU-minute of 130 GPUs is in exactly one category (total within 2% of 130 GPUs times the sampled time)
checks.because: Each sample assigns every GPU of every GPU node one category.

checks.description: each cause the design names was observed: busy, allocated but idle, waiting for a gang, fragmented, blocked by quota, and lost to preemption
checks.because: S02, S03, S06, S08 and S10 each create one of them on purpose.

checks.description: queue wait is reported for at least three size classes, from the workloads of S03 to S10
checks.because: Kueue records when each workload reserved quota; the scenarios kept those times before cleaning up.
